feishu-lark 0.1.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces a comprehensive Feishu/Lark integration skill for OpenClaw, supporting messaging (IM), group management, Bitable (multi-dimensional tables), docs, calendar, video conferencing, meeting minutes, tasks, approvals, contacts, drive, and wiki.
- Requires setup and use of the official Lark MCP server.
- Features clear documentation of supported API endpoints and standard parameter conventions.
- Includes guidance for working with user or app/bot identities (`useUAT`) and common ID types.
- Designed for extensible workflows involving multiple core Lark/Feishu services.
